rationale: The feature requires enabling Model Runtime. Runtime documentation distinguishes Data zone and Global AWS routing and allows external processing outside the Splunk platform boundary, while the Cloud Connected data section gives a broad no-third-party statement. The About page distinguishes hosted-model placement from external runtime choice. Basic assistant commercial regions, Azure runtime rows and limited IL2 assistant installation do not establish Agent Mode availability.

exclusions: No exact per-request processing location, customer authorization or data-residency commitment is established.
